note: Adapted from the genus-level account in Roonwal & Chhotani (1989) (in English), whose description is adapted from Haviland's 1898 original description and the redescription of Roonwal & Sen-Sarma (1960); the alate, soldier and pseudoworker are all described and measured. The original's pseudoworker pronotum length reads '1.10-120 mm' in the OCR and is corrected here to 1.10—1.20 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown with a reddish tinge; antennae and labrum distinctly paler; pronotum dark brown; legs and abdomen paler than the head. Body covered with long hairs, rather densely so. Body length 9.5 mm (Haviland 1898 and Holmgren 1913 give 10.5 mm). Head capsule oval with rounded sides; slightly wider than long to the base of the mandibles (length 1.80 mm, width 2.05 mm); Y suture indistinct. Compound eyes large, nearly circular (diameter 0.60 mm), adjacent to the antennae. Ocelli oval (greatest diameter 0.23 mm), touching the compound eyes. Antennae more than 13-segmented; segment 3 about as long as segment 2 or 4; segments 5 and 6 about equal. Postclypeus darker than the head, with a few bristles in front; anteclypeus almost trapezoidal, whitish and hairless. Labrum almost square, slightly wider than long (length 0.55 mm, width 0.65 mm), with a few hairs near the anterior margin and on the surface. Pronotum flat, as wide as the head, length 1.30 mm, width 2.15 mm; anterior margin deeply concave, sides rounded, posterior margin slightly incurved in the middle; margins and surface rather hairy. Wings not examined; according to Holmgren (1913) the radius extends beyond the middle of the wing, the radius sector has 5 branches in the apical third and the cubitus 14—15 branches. Apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen slender and hairy; cerci 2-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale brown to dark brown with a reddish tinge; antennae darker at the base and paler at the tip; labrum brownish; mandibles almost blackish brown with a dark reddish brown base. Head and body sparsely covered with rather long hairs. Body length 11.6—11.8 mm. Head almost rectangular and elongate (length to the base of the mandibles 3.66—4.10 mm, greatest width 2.20—2.80 mm); broader in front and narrower behind; frons sloping at about 45° in front, with a median depression running backwards from the frons to the middle of the dorsum of the head; Y suture not visible. Compound eyes translucent and oval (length 0.20—0.30 mm), about one long diameter from the antennae. Antennae 16-segmented; antennal carinae not developed; segment 3 about as long as or slightly shorter than segment 2 and more strongly sclerotized; segment 4 the shortest. Postclypeus darker than the frons, with a few hairs in front; anteclypeus whitish, hairless and narrow. Labrum almost rectangular to square (length 0.38—0.50 mm, width 0.60 mm), rounded at the anterior margin, with a few long bristles and short hairs near the tip and on the surface. Mandibles short and thick, relatively more slender than in other species; tip weakly incurved, the outer margin weakly raised at the base; length 2.2—2.3 mm. Left mandible with 5 and right mandible with 2 marginal teeth; the margin between the second and third marginal teeth of the left mandible relatively long. Postmentum long and clavate; the broader front part (club) divided into two subequal parts; the stalk long and the waist narrow; waist width about half the greatest width of the club (length 2.60—2.90 mm, greatest width 0.75—0.90 mm, waist width 0.35—0.50 mm). Pronotum flat and almost rectangular, almost as wide as the head (length 1.10—1.40 mm, width 2.10—2.55 mm); anterior margin weakly incurved; posterior margin nearly straight; sides rounded. Legs slender; apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3, tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen slender and hairy; cerci 2-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head pale yellow to pale straw; antennae, pronotum and legs paler than the head; abdomen whitish. Head and body rather densely hairy. Body length 7.20—8.50 mm. Head almost square, width about equal to length to the base of the mandibles (length 1.90—2.0 mm, width 2.0—2.30 mm). Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 longer than the sum of segments 4 and 5. Postclypeus darker and slightly convex; anteclypeus well developed. Labrum almost square and hairy. Mandibles as in the genus. Pronotum flat and almost rectangular, rather densely hairy (length 1.10—1.20 mm, width 2.10—2.20 mm); anterior margin deeply concave, posterior margin slightly concave. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
